versions.title: Auto-Updater Fix & Release v0.2.6
versions.origin: Bug fix release. Auto-updater error dialogs now only appear on manual checks, not on automatic startup checks. Cleaner user-facing error messages.

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Auto-updater error dialog no longer appears on automatic startup checks — only on manual Check for Updates
Clean, user-friendly error message instead of raw stack trace

versions.title: Scene Tab Management & Release QA
versions.origin: Quality-of-life improvements to scene tab management (drag-to-reorder, pinning, collapsible bar, scroll arrows, scene switcher in LayersPanel). History contract bug fix in keyboard shortcuts. Full pre-release audit and cleanup.

sections.heading: Scene Tabs
items: Drag-to-reorder tabs with visual drop indicator
Pin scenes to keep them anchored and protected from bulk delete
Collapsible tab bar with active scene header
Scroll arrows that step one tab at a time

sections.heading: Layers
items: Scene switcher in LayersPanel with ◀/▶ buttons

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: History contract: pushHistory called before mutations in keyboard shortcuts
Removed unused scrollbar theme tokens

sections.heading: Quality
items: Full pre-release audit, ESLint 0, TypeScript clean
231 tests passing, production build clean

versions.title: Shape System, Advanced Editors & Interactive Guides
versions.origin: Major feature release adding SVG shape system, gradient/shadow/glow editors, interactive rulers and guides, theme presets, enhanced typography, and comprehensive UI polish.

sections.heading: Shape System
items: 11 SVG shape kinds with drag, resize, and z-order
Shape fill, opacity, rotation, blur, blend mode
Shape background image upload as SVG pattern fill
Dedicated Shapes panel and layers integration

sections.heading: Advanced Editors
items: Gradient editor with unlimited stops, 4 types, angle, presets
Multi-layer shadow editor with inset and 10 presets
Multi-layer glow editor with 10 presets
Shared ColorInput, SliderInput, ToggleSwitch primitives

sections.heading: Typography & Images
items: Letter spacing, word spacing, text-transform, stroke controls
Image opacity, border-radius, blend mode, flip
Image blur, glow, and shadow effects

sections.heading: Rulers & Guides
items: Viewport ruler bars with zoom-aware tick marks
Drag from ruler onto canvas to create guides
Interactive guide lines (drag, right-click to delete)

sections.heading: Theme & UI
items: 17 color theme presets with instant apply
Device custom color theme picker
Full theme token migration across 20+ panels
Light theme support throughout sidebar and panels
Ctrl+click multi-select and nested group rendering

sections.heading: Quality
items: 231 unit tests across 14 files
TypeScript strict, ESLint zero warnings

versions.title: Initial Release
versions.origin: Started as mockup-template.html, evolved through a React+Vite legacy phase, and rewritten as a full Electron desktop application.

sections.heading: Core
items: Electron 33 desktop shell with React 18 + TypeScript
Zustand 5 state management (10 slices)
electron-vite 2 bundler (Vite 5)
Tailwind CSS 3.4

sections.heading: Devices
items: 7 device types: Monitor, Laptop, iPad, Phone, Watch, Browser, Terminal
Double-click to upload custom screen images
Object-fit: contain, cover, stretch

sections.heading: Canvas & Scene
items: Infinite canvas with zoom and pan
Multi-scene support with tab navigation
Smart snapping to edges, center, and grid
7 built-in background presets

sections.heading: Editing
items: Drag & resize at 60fps
Inline text editing with gradient, glow, shadow effects
Image overlay upload and positioning
Layer management with drag reorder, visibility, lock

sections.heading: Export & Projects
items: PNG, JPEG, WebP export at 1x-4x scale
Multi-scene export as ZIP
.mockup project files (ZIP format)
Auto-save recovery and crash protection

sections.heading: Desktop Integration
items: OS file association for .mockup files
Unsaved changes guard
Auto-update via GitHub Releases
Dark / light UI themes

sections.heading: Quality
items: 136 unit tests across 12 files
Error boundaries for crash isolation
ESLint zero warnings
